items.title: Oil up, bitcoin down as U.S. strikes Iranian crude carriers
items.summary: Bitcoin trades lower by nearly 1% as escalating U.S.-Iran hostilities push oil higher.

items.title: Harmony to fully sunset Layer 1, proposes token migration to Ethereum for AI video initiative
items.summary: Harmony said it would help validators transition to its proposed new initiative, a 'remix economy' with AI video creators.

items.title: ‘White hats’ take 4000 BTC from Liquid, ETFs see best inflows of 2026: Hodler’s Digest
items.summary: Purported white hat hackers have taken 4000 Bitcoin from the Liquid sidechain in a major security breach.

items.title: Liquid Sidechain Paused After 3,998 BTC Leaves Federation Wallet
items.summary: Blockstream's Liquid disabled its bridge nodes on Sunday after almost the entire bitcoin reserve backing L-BTC was withdrawn to a single address, whose owner wrote “we are whitehats” into a bitcoin transaction.
